name: ca-plan-bayes
description: Covered California Bayesian Health Plan Decision App

scripts.serve: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const mime = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.json': 'application/json', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml' }; http.createServer((req, res) => { const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); fs.readFile(filePath, (err, data) => { if (err) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); return; } res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': mime[path.extname(filePath)] || 'text/plain' }); res.end(data); }); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('Serving locally at http://localhost:3000'));"
